JOUR 201.title: Principles of Public Relations

JOUR 202.title: Principles of Advertising and Brand Communications

JOUR 203.title: Principles of Visual Communications

JOUR 285.title: Social Media and Society

JOUR 286.description: Skills, strategies, and knowledge necessary to build a successful career as a social media influencer.

JOUR 286.title: Social Media Influencer Blueprint: A Playbook for Online Fame and Fortune

JOUR 303.title: Law and Ethics of Mass Communications

JOUR 304.description: Examination of the origins and history of First Amendment and related law and ethics, with an emphasis on how they apply to the Internet and social media.
JOUR 304.subject: JOUR
JOUR 304.title: Internet and Social Media Law

JOUR 306.description: Survey of predominant theories in mass communications including mass media uses, functions, and effects.
JOUR 306.subject: JOUR
JOUR 306.title: Theories of Mass Communications

JOUR 307.description: Exploration of the intersection of American media, sports and race.
JOUR 307.subject: JOUR
JOUR 307.title: Media, Sports and Race

JOUR 308.title: Media and Youth

JOUR 309.subject: JOUR
JOUR 309.title: Hip Hop, Media and Society

JOUR 311.title: Race, Gender, and Class in Mass Media

JOUR 312.title: International Mass Communications

JOUR 316.title: Toolkit for Concept Development

JOUR 317.subject: JOUR
JOUR 317.title: Toolkit for Brand Communication: Creative Execution

JOUR 321.description: Introduction to revenue generation by advertiser-supported mass communication companies, with a focus on advertising technology used in sales and sales management.

JOUR 331.title: Social Media Marketing Strategy

JOUR 332.subject: JOUR
JOUR 332.title: Mass Communications Research

JOUR 334.title: Publication Writing and Design

JOUR 343.title: Social Media for Sports Media

JOUR 344.title: SEC Football and Sports Media

JOUR 345.subject: JOUR
JOUR 345.title: Gender, Sexuality, and Sports Media

JOUR 346.description: The personal computer and software related to the design and production of graphic and photographic images for print and onscreen media.
JOUR 346.subject: JOUR

JOUR 365.subject: JOUR
JOUR 365.title: Faith, Values, and the Mass Media

JOUR 371.subject: JOUR
JOUR 371.title: Social Media and Mobile Journalism

JOUR 384.title: Professional Perspectives in Business Communications

JOUR 392.title: Podcasting and Audio Production

JOUR 393.subject: JOUR
JOUR 393.title: Digital Signage

JOUR 394.description: Examination of the ethical dilemmas and moral situations that sports media members face from outside and internal sources and the ethical obligation to provide citizens with fair and balanced reporting of issues.
JOUR 394.subject: JOUR
JOUR 394.title: Sports Media Ethics

JOUR 397.title: Research Experience In Mass Communications

JOUR 398.title: Diversity Topics in Mass Media

JOUR 400.title: Digital Media and Big Data Analysis

JOUR 416.title: Advertising: Creative, Strategy, and Execution

JOUR 418.title: Advanced Creative Advertising

JOUR 419.title: Special Topics in Advertising

JOUR 421.description: Research and development of a media plan using integrated communications approach and simulation models.
JOUR 421.subject: JOUR
JOUR 421.title: Media Analysis

JOUR 422.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in JOUR 416.

JOUR 422.title: Advertising Campaigns: From Development to Pitch

JOUR 428.title: Super Bowl Commercials

Junior standing or permission of instructor.

JOUR 430.title: Creative Leadership

JOUR 442.title: Advanced Graphics for Visual Communications

JOUR 460.title: Capstone Portfolio Development

JOUR 461.title: Sports Journalism

JOUR 466.subject: JOUR
JOUR 466.title: Magazine Article Writing

JOUR 470.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in JOUR 391.
JOUR 470.subject: JOUR
JOUR 470.title: Sports Media Capstone

JOUR 472.title: Power Producing

JOUR 475.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in JOUR 361 or JOUR 447.

JOUR 475.title: Special Topics in Nonfiction Storytelling with Emerging Technologies

JOUR 483.title: Reporting and Writing About the Economy
